references.text: The description of the hangings of the court and the screen at the entrance to the court, which the Gershonites were responsible for carrying.
Mentions the hangings of the court, the screen at the gate of the court, and the cords belonging to the tabernacle and the court.
A detailed description of how the hangings of the court, the screen, and the cords were made.
Mentions the hangings of the court, the screen for the gate of the court, the cords, and the pegs.
The continuation of the description of the Gershonites' duties, including the pillars around the court with their bases, pegs, and cords.
A parallel text describing the service of the Gershonites regarding the hangings of the court and the screen at the entrance.
Mentions the pillars around the court with their bases, pegs, and cords that were to be carried.
